summary: First test run for Nestavia Zirakpur. Full backend pytest suite (19/19) covers pricing engine (weekday/weekend/extra guest/last-minute/partial/7-day rules/400s), auth (register/login/me/duplicate/wrong-password/host role), booking flow (upload receipt, create booking, host lists, approve reveals address, host fetches file, complete + review + average, double-book 409, review-before-complete 403), and host calendar (block/unblock/rate override reflected in quote). Frontend Playwright verified end-to-end: home loads with 5 gallery photos, quote breakdown reactive to guests/pay-option toggles, logged-out reserve redirects to /auth, guest register+book with receipt upload lands on /my-bookings with pending status and address-locked banner, host login lands on /host with dashboard stats + approve button, receipt image displayed, whatsapp-confirm-btn href contains wa.me and ZIRAKPUR address, complete-btn works, host calendar block turns date red and rate override label shows '₹2800' on the day cell, after completion the review-form appears in /my-bookings, submitted review shows on home reviews section, mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: get_current_user prefers cookie over Authorization header. When two different users' Bearer tokens are used from the same client with a persistent cookie jar, the cookie silently wins. This is a real gotcha but not a production bug because browser clients rotate cookies on login. Consider preferring Authorization header when explicitly provided.

Cancellation branches for hours>48 and hours<=48 both return 40% refund; spec differentiates ONLY at >=96h (100%) vs <96h (40%). Current code effectively matches spec but the elif/else duplicate is redundant/confusing — collapse into a single 40% branch.

issues: Uses browser-native <input type=date> instead of shadcn calendar — acceptable per spec, but the two date pickers render inconsistently across browsers.
Text 'For guest privacy...' uses #E6C687 gold on dark green — legible but low contrast; body copy uses white/75 which is fine.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In get_current_user, prefer Authorization header when present (avoids stale cookie shadowing a fresh Bearer token — mainly a test-tooling issue).
OPTIONAL: Simplify duplicate refund branches in cancel_booking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~745 lines in a single module — acceptable for MVP but should be split (auth/, bookings/, host/, storage/) as it grows.

PROPERTY['secret_address'] and 'secret_maps' are hardcoded in server.py AND duplicated in /app/frontend/src/components/BookingQueue.jsx (ADDRESS/MAPS constants). Any address change must be updated in both places — extract to backend and let the frontend pull from booking payload only.

Bookings endpoint /api/bookings (host) always returns raw booking docs (including receipt_file_id, transaction_ref, etc.) — fine because require_host, but confirm no PII leakage to guest-facing endpoints.
@app.on_event('startup') and 'shutdown' are deprecated in newer FastAPI; switch to lifespan.
compute_quote reads all rate_overrides for every quote — acceptable at current scale but O(N) DB scan per quote.

rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Minor DX issue: backend prefers cookies over Bearer in get_current_user (see server.py line 250) which caused initial pytest fixtures using a persistent requests.Session to fail cross-role tests. Fixed on the test side by using top-level `requests` (no cookie jar) with explicit Authorization headers per role.
